reason: Provides on-demand retrieval of persisted session history through query, slice, and grep tools, with bounded results and citations; it primarily supports agent context access.

summaries.zh: 为智能体提供按需查询、截取和搜索已持久化会话历史的工具，并返回带引用的有限结果。
summaries.en: Provides agent-facing tools to query, slice, and grep persisted session history with bounded results and citations.

capabilities: Registers context_query, context_slice, and context_grep tools for retrieving persisted session history
Reads stored session events and spill content through optional backends
May invoke the packaged ripgrep binary for bounded text search
Returns citations and bounded result windows to the model
